would you like to recharge?
silenttxt: Due to idle for too long, the line will be disconnected after the countdown.
silenttimeouttxt: Oops! You haven't played for a long time~ Please re-enter the game and show off your skills!
unbalance: Insufficient balance! would you like to recharge?
notbet: Please select an area to bet.
notsufficientfunds: The balance of chips is insufficient, please recharge as soon as possible.
reconnecttimeout: You've disconnected, please check your network connection.
rankruletxt:
1.Every time you win a gold coin, you will get a little profit point, and 
some games even double the profit.
2. Points are awarded only for betting on games with specific points.
3.The top ten players on the daily leaderboard can get ranking 
rewards and league points!
4. The top ten players in the weekly list can get generous league 
bonuses!
5. Calculate the previous day's daily ranking and distribute rewards 
every day.
6. The weekly rankings for the previous week will be settled every 
Sunday and rewards will be distributed.
7. Rewards must be claimed within 24 hours, expired and invalid.
ruletxt:
1. Choose your cost amount and choose the fruit to cost on;
  2. Please finish seletion before the end of the countdown,the 
results will be announced immediately after counting down;
  3. If the published result matches the fruit you selected, you will 
be rewarded according to the corresponding odds;
  4. After each round of draw, there is a possibility to activate the 
minislot game,
    The slot result may be one of the following bonus:
    Fruit +1, Fruit +2, Fruit +3, Bonus x2, Bonus x3, Jackpot 
bonus, or there may not be any bonus.
  5. The official bonus pool will increase as more users participate 
in the game,
    winners will have the opportunity to get "JACKPOT"bonus!
    The opening amount of the "Jackpot" is calculated in the following 
way:
    The winners get 10% of the jackpot for cost of 1,000 - 9,999;
    The winners get 30% of the jackpot for cost of 10,000 - 99,999;
    The winners get 50% of the jackpot for cost of 100,000 - 999,999;
    The winners get 70% of the jackpot when their cost are greater than or equal to 1,000,000.
    "JACKPOT" bonus distribution rules:
    -Distribute according to the proportion of the winners cost in this round,
    -Example: If there are 3 winners, and their cost are 100, 20, and 1 respectively, the total bonus will be divided into 121 parts, and the winners will receive 100, 20, and 1 respectively.
